tasks.label: Dependency check and production build
args: if exist node_modules (echo DEPENDENCIES: node_modules exists; install skipped) else (echo DEPENDENCIES: node_modules absent; running npm install & npm install) & npm run build

tasks.label: Conditional install and build
args: const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('node_modules')) console.log('DEPENDENCIES: node_modules exists; install skipped.'); else { console.log('DEPENDENCIES: node_modules absent; running npm install'); let r=cp.spawnSync('npm.cmd',['install'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status||1); } console.log('BUILD: running npm run build'); const r=cp.spawnSync('npm.cmd',['run','build'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); console.log('npm run build exit code:',r.status); process.exit(r.status||0);

tasks.label: Install dependencies and build client
args: cd /d "D:\My Projects\Dental Clinic\client" & npm install & echo CLIENT_NPM_INSTALL_EXIT=!ERRORLEVEL! & cd /d "D:\My Projects\Dental Clinic\server" & npm install & echo SERVER_NPM_INSTALL_EXIT=!ERRORLEVEL! & cd /d "D:\My Projects\Dental Clinic" & npm install --package-lock-only & echo ROOT_LOCK_ONLY_EXIT=!ERRORLEVEL! & cd /d "D:\My Projects\Dental Clinic\client" & npm run build & echo CLIENT_BUILD_EXIT=!ERRORLEVEL!
